notes.title: 2024.03 devlog
notes.content:
Hello, Veteran agents of Kusan!

The main activities over the past two months are as follows.

- 2 Chapter boss combat
- Added ‘pt-br’ language

Please check below for more details!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/0dd311058699db6c68f8fe52045a8dc593eb8f42.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/6d011a3b049bf876311ac930e494b1158fe16174.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/0c1af8539180b5423f8503b9b6463b7f27507505.gif[/img]
[h3]2Chapter Boss Combat[/h3]

We set the keyword for the 2nd chapter boss as 'Giant Boss' and began development. During the process, we referenced the 2nd boss from Metal Slug 2, 'Aeshi-Nero'.

The gifs above showcase the patterns of the giant boss we created.

We aimed to depict Jin confronting the spatial pressure emanating from the boss's massive stature, turning it into a combat.

However, some patterns didn't quite mesh well with the game and felt overly monotonous.

So, we're redesigning the rhythm of the boss combat experience and crafting patterns with a faster tempo.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/1237f799158b3430252147b035aa5f34c9194ccb.png[/img]
[h3]User Translation[/h3]

After the second playtest, we opened up a user participation translation sheet to seek assistance from those willing to translate.

(You can find the translation sheet on our Discord channel.)

https://discord.com/channels/945317947684032572/945552318550667264/1201424619199017030

The ‘pt-br’ shown in the image above is one of the translations we received.

We sincerely appreciate your translation support.

However, we are currently contemplating the opening of the translation sheet for chapters that have not yet been released. This is because spoilers could potentially diminish the enjoyment of the game. We would like to hear your thoughts on this matter.

notes.title: Apr. Devlop Note 🔧
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/34631e0cd59db832dfce2fe8936501f28a8af20a.png[/img]

Hello, players!

Starting in mid-March, we started working on a two-chapter project for early access, and in Stage 2-1, we produced a one-time QTE that punches cars that rush into Jin.

However, even at the actual level, there were opinions that it would be fun to crush the vehicle with a fist, and various ideas were added to create a new vehicle.

The car made like this currently has three rules.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/8783cc28637c2692037a518a1a452f70211da1f1.gif[/img]
1. The vehicle carries the enemy. During the battle, vehicles will enter the battle under certain conditions. After a designated time on a stopped vehicle, enemies pop out and track you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/6a712e40d99c1b6276929d7d591fdc4bba1fc61b.gif[/img]
2. Certain vehicles rush into the player. The Jin that touches the vehicle will die. You need to avoid the vehicle, but if you're brave, you can punch the vehicle. The vehicle that touches the fist is immediately crushed and the enemies on board are shocked and bounced off.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/7b5d328fa4e56b5d8a6483c226d6be71fe6fa730.gif[/img]
3. If you're good at aiming, you can shoot the driver in the vehicle. When the driver dies, the vehicle hits the wall and explodes.


* Please be advised that the above three features are still in the prototype stage, so rules may be added or removed. What do you think about this development log? Leave feedback on the discussion board! Thank you for reading this long article.

notes.title: Demo Patch Note!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028530/87308a23f3445acf2e0e71d6735354df7d514e59.png[/img]

Hello, players!
Thank you for playing the demo!
As soon as the Steam Fest period was over, We couldn't do much work because I had COVID-19.
Still, we selected some of the feedback that users posted on the Steam Community and Discord and proceeded with the patch.
The patch contents are as follows.

In Upgrade UI cannot use mouse but seems possible

- Diable crosshair in Upgrade UI

In Upgrade UI ‘Yes’, ‘No’ confused about which one was chosen

- Change coloring of not chosen one
- Can be selected into one direction

When killed by Mike Axe( = White Mouse), difficult to recognize the cause of death

- Change attack animation of Mike Axe → add ‘Anticipation’, ‘Recovery’ motion
- Increase player character’s feeling of hit → add Blood effect, Pushing effect
- Change location of ‘Press R to Restart’

We always look closely at what you uploaded and proceed according to the priorities.
Maybe the feedback you posted will be reflected right now.
However, we are always thinking carefully and deciding to reflect our feedback, so please give us a lot of feedback!
Thank you! :)

notes.title: Hot fix) We just rebalanced the difficulty of boss! 😅
notes.content:
Sorry for the difficulty! 
We hear many feedbacks about boss's unfairness.
Really sorry for the inconvenience. 😥
One of my friend took more than 2 hours but he couldn't beat the boss yet...
This is not what we wanted for the 1st boss of the game.
We just fixed few things below.

 - (boss) Decrease Boss's HP 140 -> 120.
 - (boss) Add 0.5 seconds delay right after the restart.
 - (boss) Slow down the timing of 2nd Turning lasers.
 - (boss) But! decrease the Fury decreasing rate 4.0 -> 3.0 (more often Fury attacks)

 Below are for the freezing when join the garage during talking 'Ayn'.
 - Change positions of 'Ayn'
 - basement architecture

And Etc.
 - fixing repeat the same scene in the final cutscene.

Hope you enjoy the Demo players!
Really thanks for playing our game:))
